title: Fan Cowl Door — Installation on the Nacelle and Latch Alignment Check

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of a fan cowl door on the nacelle, with the hinge pin insertion sequence, the drain line restraint and the latch alignment and closing force check that releases the aircraft.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install a fan cowl door on the nacelle, to restrain the drain line clear of the aft intercostals and to do the latch alignment and closing force check.
sections.job_setup_note: A converted door and an unconverted door can both be latched to the same nacelle, but the closing force acceptance figure differs and the correct figure must be taken from the door standard, not from the aircraft standard. The drain line route changes on a converted door because the aft intercostals occupy its original path. The closing force check is the acceptance step: a door that needs more than the stated force must not be released.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm the door standard from the door identification plate and select the matching closing force figure. 2. Remove the blanking covers from the nacelle hinge fittings and the latch keepers. 3. Bring the door up on the trestle with two persons and align the aft hinge lug. 4. Insert the aft hinge pin and secure it. 5. Align the forward hinge lug and insert the forward hinge pin, then secure it. CAUTION: DO NOT FORCE A HINGE PIN. A PIN THAT DOES NOT ENTER BY HAND MEANS THE DOOR IS NOT ALIGNED AND FORCING IT DAMAGES THE LUG BORE. 6. Engage both hold-open rods and lock them, then remove the trestle. 7. Restrain the drain line with new cable ties on the route shown for the door standard fitted, clear of the aft intercostals. 8. Release the hold-open rods and close the door. 9. Latch the door in the sequence given in the figure, forward to aft. 10. Measure the closing force at the aft latch and confirm it is within the figure for the door standard. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE AIRCRAFT IF THE AFT LATCH NEEDS MORE THAN THE STATED CLOSING FORCE. A FORCED LATCH CAN BE LEFT UNMADE. 11. Confirm the latch indicators are all showing latched from outside the nacelle. 12. Do the door seal contact check around the full periphery.
sections.close_out: Confirm all latches are made and all indicators show latched. Record the door serial number, the door standard, the measured closing force and the nacelle position in the aircraft maintenance record. Report any door needing more than the stated closing force before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The closing force acceptance figure differs for a door post MOD-148710; take it from the door identification plate.

safety_precautions: Do not force a hinge pin.
Engage and lock both hold-open rods before the trestle is removed.
Confirm the wind speed is below the door opening limit.
